output.reason: The brief makes a convincing site-level case that the app and the coordinator cuts together caused the drop, backed by specific booking and callback numbers, and its next steps are concrete; but it says Quarry Lane is "not on the app" without explaining why, when the rollout plan scheduled it to go live on 14 April, and that unexplained gap weakens its key control comparison.
